items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: There's the man that's responsible for rhythm.

ctx.x: Then I went from vaudeville to opera. Getting back to the show, closing "Blackbirds" --

Before we get into this. I know last Friday night at the performance at Royce Hall, Tap Two, Honey Coles said from the stage, pointing to you, "There's the man that's responsible for rhythm. The rhythm that you saw us doing on the stage -- there's the man that really started it."
